dedupe_keys.name: form eia 923 power plant operations report monthly and annual us generation fuel consumption stocks and receipts by plant

description: Form EIA-923 collects detailed electric power data, monthly and annually, on electricity generation, fuel consumption, fossil fuel stocks and fuel receipts at the power plant and prime mover level in the United States. Its schedules cover fuel receipts and costs, generator generation, fuel consumption and stocks, fossil fuel stocks, the source and disposition of electricity at non-utility plants, and environmental data. The monthly survey covers about 3,034 plants, and the annual final data add about 9,528 plants from the annual survey; files carry earlier data from the predecessor forms EIA-906 and EIA-920. When read, the latest monthly release was 24 September 2026 with June 2026 data, and the final 2025 annual data were released on 14 September 2026; a corrections list documents re-released files. Coverage is US power plants. Files are zipped Excel workbooks, free to download; as US government works they are in the public domain and EIA asks for acknowledgement. Caveats: monthly data cover a sample of plants and are revised in the annual release, and plant level coal and petroleum coke stocks have release restrictions noted by EIA. Simulation uses are plant generation and fuel inputs for dispatch, fuel supply disruption and emissions models. Related records: data-eia-860-annual-electric-generator-report gives the generator inventory, and data-pudl joins both.
